theme_archetype.name: Swiss & High-Contrast (Modern Mobility)
theme_archetype.description: A high-contrast, strictly functional and modern Uber-like interface. Uses stark white, extreme dark navy/black, and vivid taxi yellow. Prioritizes legibility, large touch targets, and outdoor visibility.

mobile_apps.customer: Mobile-first view. Full-screen map with overlapping bottom sheet (rounded-t-[32px], bg-white, shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]).
mobile_apps.driver: Mobile-first view. Floating action cards with generous padding, large text.

admin_dashboard.sidebar: w-64 bg-[#1A1A1A] text-white flex-shrink-0 min-h-screen sticky top-0. Active nav items use bg-[#FFC400] text-[#1A1A1A] rounded-xl font-bold.
admin_dashboard.cards: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-neutral-100 p-6

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFC400] text-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-[#E6B000] font-bold rounded-2xl py-4 px-6 transition-all transform active:scale-[0.98] w-full text-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1A1A1A] text-white hover:bg-black font-bold rounded-2xl py-4 px-6 transition-all transform active:scale-[0.98] w-full text-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#1A1A1A] text-[#1A1A1A] font-bold rounded-2xl py-4 px-6 transition-all transform active:scale-[0.98] w-full text-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.accept: bg-[#10B981] text-white rounded-2xl py-4 px-6 font-bold text-lg active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.decline: bg-[#EF4444] text-white rounded-2xl py-4 px-6 font-bold text-lg active:scale-[0.98]

inputs.default: bg-[#F3F4F6] border-none rounded-xl px-4 py-4 text-base font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FFC400] focus:bg-white transition-all w-full outline-none

status_badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold gap-1.5

driver_card.layout: flex items-center gap-4 bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-neutral-100
driver_card.plate_badge: bg-[#FFC400] text-[#1A1A1A] px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

animations.loading: animate-pulse for skeletons, pinging absolute dot (bg-[#FFC400]) for searching driver state

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure #FFC400 has #1A1A1A text for WCAG AA compliance. Do not use white text on yellow.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, toggles, and status badges MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='admin-login-button', data-testid='driver-accept-ride').

instructions_to_main_agent: Language: ALL copy MUST be in German. (e.g., 'Jetzt Taxi', 'Später bestellen', 'Fahrt planen', 'Fahrer gefunden', 'Frei', 'Besetzt', 'Fahrer', 'Kunden', 'Preise', 'Einstellungen').
Map Integration: Use 'react-leaflet' or similar map component. The map is the absolute core of the driver and customer mobile views.
Customer App Layout: Mobile viewport dimensions on desktop, or fully responsive mobile-first web. The map sits behind a white bottom sheet.

Driver App Layout: Similar mobile-first approach. Needs a prominent toggle for 'Frei/Offline' (Green/Gray) and large actionable cards for incoming rides with 'Annehmen' (Accept/Green) and 'Ablehnen' (Decline/Red).
Admin Dashboard: Built for desktop web. Left sidebar in #1A1A1A, active states in #FFC400. Top KPI cards, large data tables with status badges.
Icons: Use lucide-react. specifically MapPin, Navigation, User, Car, Clock, Shield.
Fonts: Install '@fontsource/plus-jakarta-sans' and '@fontsource/manrope'. Apply to Tailwind theme configuration.
Component Library: You may use Shadcn UI, but heavily customize buttons/cards to be rounded-2xl (16px radius) and borders to be subtle. Override Shadcn default borders and radius.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header over light content without glassmorphism. Ensure top legibility.
